events.verdict: Siakam (IND) firms up in a screening position in Dort's (OKC) path and absorbs the contact.
Dort (OKC) avoids making any illegal contact with Siakam (IND) during his jump shot attempt.
Toppin (IND) moves alongside Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Holmgren (OKC) rests a forearm against Walker (IND) that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Walker (IND) grabs Holmgren's (OKC) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Holmgren (OKC) directly contests Mathurin's (IND) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Mathurin's (IND) hand after the release.
Siakam (IND) directly contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Gilgeous-Alexander's hand after the release.
Holmgren (OKC) directly contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Siakam's (IND) hand after the release.
Toppin (IND) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Dort (OKC) and Mathurin (IND) briefly engage and disengage after Mathurin releases the throw-in.
Holmgren (OKC) directly contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Siakam's (IND) hand after the release.
Hartenstein (OKC) establishes a position in Mathurin's (IND) path and absorbs the contact.
Walker (IND) legally contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Toppin (IND) is established in a position in Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path and the two players briefly engage following the screen.

Mitchell (OKC) is in a legal position alongside of Mathurin's (IND) path to the basket. After Mathurin releases the shot attempt, his forward momentum carries him into Holmgren (OKC), who is in a legal, vertical position.
Sheppard (IND) moves laterally into Mitchell (OKC) after his gather, initiating more-than-marginal contact during the driving shot attempt.
Toppin (IND) places a hand against Mitchell (OKC), who lifts his own arm upwards into it, but Mitchell is allowed to move freely.
Mitchell (OKC) loses his balance as he comes together with Mathurin (IND) at the same spot, but Mitchell is not dislodged from his position as a result of any illegal contact.
Dort (OKC) avoids making any illegal contact with Siakam (IND) during his jump shot attempt.

Sheppard (IND) places an arm against Mitchell (OKC), impeding his ability to move off of the ball. Although Mitchell lifts his own arm into Sheppard's arm, the initial illegal contact during the sequence is by Sheppard.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Walker (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.

Mathurin (IND) places a forearm against Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) during his drive to the basket and shot attempt and the contact is marginal. Mathurin does not extend his forearm into Gilgeous-Alexander during the shot attempt.
